newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota May domestic output up 8.2% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Toyota May domestic output up 8.2% yr/yr.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday that its domestic vehicle production rose 8.2 percent from a year earlier to 281,050 vehicles in May.
May exports rose 14.5 percent year-on-year to 120,317 vehicles, it said, while domestic sales fell 8.8 percent from a year earlier to 127,777 units.
Domestic production rose in May for a third successive month on a year-on-year basis.
Vehicle exports rose for the second successive month due to higher exports to Europe, Asia and North America, while domestic sales fell for the second successive month.
Toyota's overseas production rose for a ninth month in a row due to steadily expanding production at its Kentucky plant and Thailand unit, it said.
